task.title: Overlay-stack hardening: two unreachable-today one-liners
task.description: Filed from the P6-189 round-2 review (2026-08-10). Two latent hazards in the shared overlay components, both unreachable from current call sites, both one-line fixes: (1) popover.rs on_cleanup guards stack removal with open.get_untracked(), so a future call site that closes and unmounts a popover in one synchronous handler strands a stack entry — permanently breaking Escape for every dialog underneath for the rest of the session; remove unconditionally (remove is a no-op for absent ids). (2) dialog.rs push Effect re-runs on open.set(true) when already open (RwSignal::set notifies unconditionally), promoting the dialog above its own open child popover and resurrecting the Escape-closes-both bug; guard the push on prev != Some(true). Re-run the Escape e2e regression test in collection-tree-manage.spec.ts after both. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.
